findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new value `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian (it matches `messages_it.properties:138` almost word for word), not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users setting up OTP will see Italian text in the account console. The same Italian string went into `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71` (`loginTotpStep1`). Use a Lithuanian translation of `Install one of the following applications on your mobile:` (`themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/account/messages/messages_en.properties:150`), e.g. `Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:`, or delete the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian. Lithuanian users on the login OTP setup page will see Italian. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation of `messages_en.properties:128` (`Install one of the following applications on your mobile:`), or delete the key.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file now has a Traditional Chinese totpStep1
findings.body: `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional characters and Taiwan wording (手機, 安裝, 應用程式), which belongs in zh_TW. The rest of this file, and `loginTotpStep1` in `login/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties:123` (`在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`), are Simplified. Use a Simplified form such as `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax in an i18next bundle breaks interpolation
findings.body: This bundle is read by i18next (`js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-34`). It uses the default `{{x}}` interpolation, and the neighbouring keys follow that convention (`error-invalid-length='{{0}}' must have a length between {{1}} and {{2}}.` at line 2995). Changing `{{0}}` to `{0}` and adding `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` means the admin console will show the literal placeholders and the raw choice pattern instead of the attribute name and limits. The same change was made in `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188`, which is loaded by i18next with default interpolation (`js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-43`). I found no step that converts `{0}` to `{{0}}` in `ThemeResource` or in the UI code. Keep `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` here and use i18next plurals if you need the singular form. The MessageFormat version only belongs in the FreeMarker-rendered `themes/.../base/*` bundles.

findings.title: Anchor violation message omits key and file
findings.body: `Didn't find anchor tag <...> in original string` doesn't say which file or key failed. Across dozens of bundles that makes the build failure hard to track down; the `Illegal HTML` message at line 111 does include both. Add `key` (already passed in) and `file`. Also, `santizeAnchors` walks the English anchors in order (line 154), so a correct translation that puts two links in a different order is rejected. If that is intended, say so in the Javadoc at line 148.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart throws RuntimeException instead of a verifier message
findings.body: The English path is built with an unanchored `replaceAll` on the absolute path (lines 74-75). When that file doesn't exist, the code throws a bare `RuntimeException`, while the rest of `verify()` reports problems through `messages` or `MojoExecutionException`. A bundle without an `_en` sibling therefore crashes the plugin with a stack trace and no actionable message. The test fixture had to be renamed from `duplicate_keys.properties` to `duplicateKeys_en.properties` for the same reason. Consider adding a message, or throwing `MojoExecutionException`, that names the expected English file.

contracts.action: verify() now runs verifySafeHtml, which reads the translated bundle and a derived English bundle and checks each value with the OWASP sanitizer
contracts.equivalent_path: verifyNoDuplicateKeys in the same class, which reports problems by adding to `messages`
contracts.before_after: verifyNoDuplicateKeys reads the contents and adds to messages; verifySafeHtml reopens the file as a PropertyResourceBundle, derives the English path by regex, and adds Illegal HTML and anchor messages
contracts.visible_effect: Messages returned from verify() are reported by the mojo as build failures
contracts.failure_mode: When the English file is missing or unreadable, a RuntimeException propagates out of verify() instead of a MojoExecutionException or a message

contracts.action: English error-invalid-multivalued-size in the i18next bundles switched to MessageFormat {0}/choice syntax
contracts.equivalent_path: Other validation keys in the same bundle use {{0}} i18next interpolation
contracts.before_after: Before: {{0}} placeholders interpolated by i18next. After: {0} and choice pattern, which i18next's default interpolation does not process

summary:
I found five fixes and two suggestions. The new HTML/anchor check in the theme verifier works as designed, but some of the translation changes made to satisfy it are wrong:
- Both Lithuanian TOTP strings (account and login) were replaced with Italian text.
- The zh_CN account TOTP string is now in Traditional Chinese.
- In the admin and account console English bundles, the multivalued-size message moved from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to Java MessageFormat syntax. i18next does not process that syntax, so the consoles would likely show the raw placeholders; I found no step that converts them, but did not trace the full rendering path.

The two suggestions are for the verifier itself: the anchor error message names neither the file nor the key, and a missing English file crashes the plugin with a bare RuntimeException instead of reporting a message.
